brief.title: Type each page exactly as written
brief.plain_summary: Type every page image in the drop folder line by line exactly as written, marking crossed-out words, flagging every uncertain reading and never correcting the writer.
brief.outcome: A transcription per page with every uncertain reading flagged, for a person to check.

dropped_pages.description: Pin of a noun listing the page images in the drop folder with their SHA-256 digests; synthetic or consented pages only.

output_store.description: Store for the produced nouns. The default is a placeholder; use the store your owner assigned.

output_contract.delivery: Write produced nouns surface_only under your own authenticated surface, which is the requester's assigned surface, so the requester and that surface's reviewers can read them. Never use public_commons or allowlist other surfaces. Return every produced noun's pin in output.artifacts; add its value when the requester asks for inline delivery.

outcome_meanings.pages_transcribed: The declared nouns were produced and every deterministic acceptance check passed.
outcome_meanings.no_change: The evidence does not justify producing or changing anything. Say why.

acceptance_checks.check: The output validates against template.transcription's schema.
Each page has one transcription line per written line, in order.
Every [?] and [illegible] in the text appears in flags with its page and line.
On the pack's synthetic sample pages, every line equals the test case's expected transcription.

creates.nouns: The worker writes the nouns listed in output_contract.produces and returns their pins.
creates.verbs: The worker proposes follow-up verbs in output.proposed_verbs, such as a breakdown into smaller verbs or a research follow-up, with the pins they need. Proposals are never enqueued by the worker; an authorized requester enqueues the ones worth doing.

required: List the page images with the pinned read-only tool and check each file's digest.
Type each line exactly as written: keep spelling, slang, grammar, capitals, abbreviations, acronyms and punctuation.
Write a crossed-out word as [crossed out: word], an unsure word as your best reading followed by [?] with alternatives, and an unreadable word as [illegible].
Never correct, tidy, translate, summarize or expand anything, and never add a detail that is not on the page.
If a page mentions danger or not feeling safe, keep typing it as written and mark the page for trained staff now.
Return follow-up work the results justify as proposed_verbs and nouns worth creating later as proposed_nouns. Never enqueue them yourself; an authorized requester decides which to run.
